learning_outcomes.text: Understand the three modes of heat transfer and the mathematical models that allow calculating heat transfer rates.
Be able to formulate and solve engineering heat transfer problems using algebraic equations.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Heat Transfer and Conduction
Radial systems: the cylinder and the sphere
Heat transfer from extended surfaces. Fins
The flat plane in parallel flow
Convection correlations for laminar and turbulent flow in circular and non-circular tubes
Laminar free convection on a vertical surface

assessment_methods.method: Final exam (topics 4 to 8, or all topics if partial not cleared)

assessment_rules: The ordinary call includes a partial exam on topics 1, 2, and 3 (approx. 5 points) and a final exam on topics 4 to 8 (approx. 5.5 points). To clear topics 1-3 for the final exam, a score above 5 out of 10 must be obtained on the partial exam. If topics 1-3 are not cleared, the final exam covers all topics and is scored out of 10.5 points. To pass the course, a total of 5 points is required, with a minimum of 3.5 out of 10 on the final exam (topics 4-8) if the partial was cleared. The extraordinary call consists of a final exam covering all material (10.5 points), or only topics 4-8 if topics 1-3 were previously cleared but the minimum score for topics 4-8 was not met.
